subject: Shiny server does not work without Internet connection?

messages.author: 4f6cf6a6ad1dd3bc
messages.subject: Shiny server does not work without Internet connection?
parts:
Dear developers! Thank`s for a useful tool first. 

I was properly setup and run all requested components. All work fine (at a beginning). 
After that, I am unplug Internet connection and see, that WebGL application does not work (web samples do not show 3D component).
Is it a bug or fich? 

With best regards,
Roman.

messages.subject: Re: Shiny server does not work without Internet connection?
parts: Please say, may I use shiny-server with RGL without connection to cdn.sockjs.org? Now it (shiny+rgl) does not work without Internet.

messages.subject: Re: Shiny server does not work without Internet connection?
parts:
I'm not sure, if this is really a good idea, but I could circumvent this issue by downloading http://cdn.sockjs.org/sockjs-0.3.min.js to my local webserver und changing this address to my local webservers in lib/node_modules/shiny-server/R/SockJSAdapter.R.

Regards
Thomas
